entries.notes: The stated range omits two figures the project itself registered or cites (90,000; 60,000). Its lower bound 65,000 is the French's own figure as Schönhals reports it.

entries.evidence: Schönhals p. 178 (page image): the Guards' row "K. russische Garden | Grossfürst Constantin | Waren am Morgen in Schlachtordnung | GL. Kollowrizow | GM. Jancowitz" in the table "Ordre de Bataille des verbündeten Heeres in der Schlacht von Austerlitz". The project's 6B reading: "supports the project's rg_cav commander 'Kologrivov' (as 'GL. Kollowrizow'): a second source for that name, as the data's strengthNote asks." Duffy p. 184 heading (S5.7; text layer): "Lt.-Gen. of Cavalry Kologrivov". Sokolov p. 199, https://archive.org/download/1799-1805-.-ii/page/n198_w1600.jpg: "Генерал-лейтенант Кологривов, командующий всей гвардейской кавалерией".

entries.claim: Kamensky's brigade: the Fanagoria Grenadier and Ryazhsk Musketeer regiments, "About 2,000 each, with dragoons, Cossacks and pioneers attached (Duffy, via the Langeron column return)"
entries.evidence: Sokolov p. 195: "Г-м Каменский 1-й, шеф Фанагорийского грен. полка | Ряжский мушк. полк 3 б-на | Фанагорийский грен. полк 3 б-на". Schönhals p. 177: the brace of "GM. Kamerskay" over "Kurskoy 3 2000 / Riasky 3 2000 / Tanagorsky 3 2000".
